title: Sovereign Cloud / Air-Gapped Deployment Canonical Spec
purpose: Operationalizes ADR-0164. Declares the per-pack air_gap overlay, on-prem dependency substitution matrix, regulator binding, and CI enforcement.

container_registry.signature_verification: Sigstore Cosign + Kyverno admission controller (per ADR-0146 / SLSA L3)

secret_store.external: AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault
secret_store.in_cell: OpenBao (BSL-free Vault fork) + HSM-backed seal (per ADR-0043)

audit_chain_shard.rule: per ADR-0162, sovereign tenants get dedicated shards with in-cell storage + sealing keys
audit_chain_shard.fleet_wide_root_publication: in-region only (no external trust-portal anchor); quarterly offline-media publication acceptable per regulator

external_api_egress.policy: DENY by default; Istio ServiceEntry absent for external hosts; Cilium L7 egress policy denies

ci_runner_option.rule: sovereign tenants may require in-region CI runners
ci_runner_option.implementation: per-pack overlay points deploy pipeline at in-region self-hosted runners in separate build cell

ci_assertions: air-gap packs reference no external host in ServiceEntry / NetworkPolicy egress
image references in air-gap pack manifests rewritten to in-cell Harbor
foundry-providers external LLM client code is absent from air-gap pack image build
OpenBao Helm chart present + HSM-backed seal configured
per-pack compliance attestation document present at microservices/governance/catalog/pack-{name}-air-gap-attestation.md
